QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_19

question.text: Under SEBI (AIF) Regulations, a Cat III AIF scheme must have a minimum corpus of:

explanation.text: The Logic: Minimum corpus of any AIF scheme is INR 20 crore. This is uniform across Cat I/II/III categories. The Trap: 10, 50, 100 cr are fictional lower/higher thresholds. The 20 cr rule is uniform. Note: The workbook fixes the INR 20 crore regulatory minimum corpus; commercial-floor commentary about Cat III viability is not part of the syllabus.
